same_vm_revision_comparison.pairing: Three fresh baseline/candidate deployment pairs on one VM, alternating first revision; native comparison also retained separately.
same_vm_revision_comparison.scope: Single-node API-accepted steady load; matched aggregate budgets; CPU and RSS include broker and MinIO.
same_vm_revision_comparison.interpretation: CPU and query p99 improve in each of the three paired deployments. RSS and ingest p99 vary and do not establish a consistent improvement. All entries pass the matched-workload, resource-coverage, host-activity and error gates.
